what_happened: Live reproduction of the dispatch's naive basename-grep orphan check found the false-positive set has grown from 16 (present-extension talk/contents templates) to 39, with a second extension (founder's deck/contents templates, 23 files) now exhibiting the identical directory-reference pattern. Corrected the regression fixture floor from 16 to 39 in the research report before Phase 1 probe design proceeds.

The research report pre-answered three questions the plan would otherwise have had to re-derive: the corrected 39-file regression floor (vs the dispatch's stale 16), the absence of a merged index.json in the source store (22 per-extension index-entries.json files instead), and a definitive negative verdict on context-file-granularity telemetry. Planning needed no re-derivation and no second research round.

Research recommended naming the probe scripts/context-inventory.sh, but the task's declared file_scope names scripts/context-reachability.sh (and tests/test-context-reachability.sh). Plan follows the declared file_scope names to avoid a cosmetic file-scope excursion; divergence recorded in the plan's Research Integration section.

The dispatch requires Phase 3's removal/merge targets to be named individually and added to file_scope AT PLAN TIME, but those targets are only knowable after the probe RUNS at implement time. Resolved by making the live-run phase a decision gate: the expected-empty confirmed-dead set closes with Reasoned Exclusions citing the probe verdict, and a non-empty set STOPS and reports rather than editing undeclared paths.

verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 reported 7 FAIL issues from check-extension-docs.sh (deployed-script content drift on git-commit-scoped.sh/lint-scoped-commit-boundary.sh/orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh/test-git-commit-scoped.sh/test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, plus Rule R line_count mismatches on formats/return-metadata-file.md and standards/git-staging-scope.md). All 7 are attributable to sibling task 304's concurrent, uncommitted/in-flight source-store edits (confirmed against its declared file_scope), not to this task's own edits. This task's own new files (context-reachability.sh, its test) were correctly reported as 'script not deployed, skipping drift check' (informational only, not part of the 7 FAIL count).

Phase 6 decision gate: confirmed-dead set is EMPTY (0 of 591 files). Closed the removal/merge/split sub-steps via Reasoned Exclusions in ranked-disposition.md rather than performing any edit -- matches the research's own expected outcome exactly. No file_scope excursion needed.
